that will provide $490M in new capital and reduce its debt.
The financing includes $350M of new junior debt and $140M of additional senior debt.

Brightline Trains Florida, which operates the Miami-to-Orlando service, has not filed for Chapter 11, although certain other Brightline entities have filed for bankruptcy protection as part of the restructuring.
The company said its Miami-Orlando operations will not be affected by the restructuring.
Its business has continued to grow, with ridership up 14% and revenue up 17% YTD through August from the same period last year.

title: Assured Guaranty backs Brightline's $490M debt restructuring
